verdict.rationale: Undermind exposes an MCP server with tools mirroring core UI capabilities (deep search, full-text PDF Q&A, note creation, curating/starring papers) and separately claims a programmatic API for enterprise customers, but there's no public OpenAPI/API documentation confirming full parity, and probes for machine-readable docs (llms.txt, openapi.json) all 404'd. Missing for 10: publicly accessible API reference matching the full UI feature set (e.g., alerts/notifications, workspace management), and independent confirmation that API/MCP access covers 100% of UI functionality rather than just search/read/write basics.
